name: floyd-warshall
description: Calculates shortest paths between all pairs of vertices in a weighted graph, supporting negative edge weights.
aiPromptContext: Use this block when you need to calculate the shortest path distances between all pairs of nodes in a weighted graph (dense graphs or graphs with negative edge weights).

parameters.name: graph
parameters.description: Adjacency list where keys are node IDs and values are arrays of { node, weight } objects.
